D: Dinosaurs now live alongside people, and a plague of giant locusts leads the heroes to a sanctuary in the Dolomites.
P: Serve the snacks when the raptors chase Owen through the streets of Malta.
S: the black market chase through Malta
Puff pastry filled with ricotta and pea and onion, folded into little parcels and baked at 200C for 20 minutes until flaky.
the giant locusts eating the crops
Corn cobs boiled 6 minutes, brushed with chilli lime butter and charred on a hot grill, cut into rounds.
Owen wrangling dinosaurs in the Sierra Nevada

Beef topside sliced thin, marinated overnight in soy, Worcestershire and garlic, dried at 75C for 4 hours. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice across the grain into 3mm strips, trimming any fat. Mix 80ml soy, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry, lay on wire racks over trays and dry at 75C for 4 hours with the oven door slightly open until chewy but bendy. Cool fully before serving.
M: the Biosyn sanctuary in the Italian Dolomites
Creamy polenta stirred with butter and parmesan, topped with a mushroom and sausage ragù simmered an hour.

Chicken thighs braised with red wine, tomato, garlic, bay and peas for an hour, with crusty bread. Season 8 chicken thigh cutlets and brown in olive oil, then set aside. Soften 1 onion and 4 garlic cloves, add 250ml red wine and bubble for 2 minutes. Add a 400g tin crushed tomatoes, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 3 bay leaves and 250ml chicken stock. Return the chicken, cover and simmer 50 minutes. Add 1 cup frozen peas for the last 5 minutes. Serve with crusty bread.
W: the dinosaur DNA trapped in amber
Sugar, golden syrup and honey boiled to 150C, bicarb whisked in so it foams, set and broken into amber shards.
K: Chilled Maltese almond milk scented with vanilla and a hint of clove, poured over ice with toasted flaked almonds on top. Soak 200g blanched almonds in water overnight, then drain. Blend with 1L cold water for 2 minutes and strain through a clean cloth, squeezing well. Stir in 3 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of ground cloves. Chill 1 hour. Toast 2 tbsp flaked almonds in a dry pan. Pour over ice in 4 glasses and scatter with the almonds.

s.note: the black market chase through Malta
s.how: Mix 250g ricotta with an egg. Separately cook 200g peas with a diced onion and a pinch of curry powder. Fill puff pastry squares with one or the other, fold into parcels and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until flaky.

s.note: the giant locusts eating the crops
s.how: Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes. Brush with butter mixed with chilli flakes and lime zest and juice. Char on a hot grill, turning, until blistered all over. Cut into thick rounds and pile them high, before the locusts arrive.

m.note: the Biosyn sanctuary in the Italian Dolomites
m.how: Brown 4 Italian sausages squeezed from their skins, add 250g sliced mushrooms and a can of crushed tomatoes and simmer an hour. Cook 200g polenta in 1L water until thick, then beat in butter and parmesan. Spoon the ragu over the polenta.

w.note: the dinosaur DNA trapped in amber
w.how: Boil 200g sugar, 3 tbsp golden syrup and 2 tbsp honey to 150C. Take off the heat and whisk in 2 tsp bicarb soda so it foams. Pour into a lined tin and leave to set. Break into amber shards. No mosquitoes trapped inside.

d.how: Soak 200g blanched almonds in water overnight, then drain. Blend with 1L cold water for 2 minutes and strain through a clean cloth, squeezing well. Stir in 3 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of ground cloves. Chill 1 hour. Toast 2 tbsp flaked almonds in a dry pan. Pour over ice in 4 glasses and scatter with the almonds.
